name: dna-os-compute
description: DNA OS Remote Compute Runtime (Phase 1). A standalone, headless compute daemon that serves AI inference, code read, build and test for external workspaces. Reuses the same conventions as dna-os-mcp-server / device runtime (allowlist + scope + audit); no business logic, no Production Database access, no Production credentials. Windows/Linux/Cloud-ready: pure Node.js, no OS-specific imports.
